summary.name: AI Mastering
summary.one_liner: AI Mastering is a web-based tool that automatically masters music audio, with drag-and-drop upload and adjustable loudness, mastering level, and output format.
use_cases: Automatically master a finished music track
Match loudness to a commercial release level
Balance loudness and dynamic range with a limiter
Check spectrum and loudness of a track
Export mastered audio in a chosen format
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a drag-and-drop interface for uploading music and automatically improving its sound quality. Users can set a target loudness, a mastering level, and an output format. It includes spectrum analysis and loudness analysis views. A built-in limiter is described as balancing loudness and dynamic range. The page states the goal is to bring a track's sound closer to commercial music.
notable: Automatic AI mastering with adjustable target loudness and mastering level
Built-in limiter for balancing loudness and dynamic range
caveats: Page lists a Free Plan at $0/month with unlimited mastering, but does not detail limits of paid tiers or whether any exist
Several features are described behind a sign up/login prompt; the page does not describe the full feature set in detail
